notes: South Korea batch 1 (hidden country, draft pages). Every figure is in plans/south-korea-research/. Facts checked 2026-11-28. Not filed: for owner review.

fields.label: D-2 student visa fee, stay of 91 days or more (approximate)
fields.notes: Study in Korea lists $40 for stays of 90 days or less, $70 for a multiple-entry visa valid for up to 2 entries and $90 for no entry limit. Study in Korea calls it a processing fee for the visa application form.

fields.label: Visa centre service fee, New Delhi and Kolkata
fields.notes: Charged by the VFS Global Korea Visa Application Center, in addition to the visa fee. The Embassy page says the amount includes tax. It covers New Delhi only: Mumbai and Chennai applicants should check their own consulate pages.

fields.label: Visa processing time, Embassy in New Delhi, normal application
fields.notes: The Embassy counts from the application date. Add 2 to 3 days for courier if you apply at the Kolkata centre. Urgent processing is suspended. Mumbai and Chennai times are not on this page.

fields.label: Average living costs per month, lower end
fields.notes: Study in Korea gives a range of 750,000 to 1,000,000 won a month. Housing is the biggest part.

fields.label: Average living costs per month, upper end
fields.notes: See south-korea.living.monthly_min_krw. The page lists items that add up to more than this total, so plan for the upper end.

fields.label: D-2 visa, stay allowed per issue, up to
fields.notes: Master's students can stay up to 5 years after admission in total (6 years for 3-year programmes), with extensions.

fields.label: Alien registration after entry, within
fields.notes: Applies to everyone who plans to stay more than 90 days.
